2026-08-01.text:
hi !

today has been good. wow. 4 good days in a row. its amazing how powerful your mindset is

the thing thats pushing me forward right now is, probably a stolen thought, but: there are things that i want my life to be like. things i want in my life. when i picture myself in those situations, i don't imagine my "self". i imagine another version of myself, one who does things differently. 

the analogy i scrappily put together was: imagine you are tom holland, you really want to be spiderman. great, you got the opportunity to audition. at the audition, you go "hey guys, it's me! tom holland!", and then leave. you will never land that role. instead, you go to the audition and you act like spiderman. something that you are not yet. all of a sudden, you land the role and you actually are spiderman. now, translate that to real life. think of the role you want to play, whatever it may be. now, think of how that person would act. life is constantly allowing you to audition for new roles, so if you want to fill a certain role you must 'act' like it. 

basically i just think of what the best version of myself would be doing and then do that. its strangely motivating. i was on day 2 no shower and thought, would the best version of me be doing this right now? would i be laying in bed scrolling on tiktok? of course not. i got my ass right into the shower and the rest of my day was amazing from there on out. 

im really enjoying reading the bell jar. it has this gripping element to it that i cant describe. maybe it's just all of the work i've done on focus. honestly maybe it might just be the wellbutrin LOL. either way, im able to take my headphones off, open the book, and just read. i love taking notes. its like being in a book club where the only member is myself. 

been listening to a lot of bleeod. he really grew on me more than i thought he would. i remember thinking that he was alright, definitely not bad. and super definitely not as bad as tiktok would make you think. but a week or two ago he really fully clicked for me. rascal 51 is a great album. 

im not sure i have much more to talk about today! i just got hawaiian bros for dinner. thats one thing ted k didn't consider. i can play videogames and hit buttons on my phone and 25 minutes later i have hawaiian bros at my doorstep. just something for you to chew on.

bye!
